verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves both prior major findings. Pre-session admission now classifies the complete top-level JSON value before dispatch, refuses mixed or multiple-initialize batches, and has a non-vacuous mutation witness proving a smuggled tools/call is not executed. Connection handling now uses an atomic bounded permit acquired before worker spawn, releases it through Drop on every worker exit path, refuses over-cap sockets without spawning, and includes a real-socket slow/incomplete-request test demonstrating the cap and subsequent slot recovery. The feature remains opt-in, the public documentation was updated, and no new correctness, soundness, or security defect was found in the changed paths.
